player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} Negotiation Game na re.
Nanhte shi resources na re, nanhte resources hta lu ai kaw na shi hta wa shi hku shi ra ai.
Nanhte hku shi resources na re:
	+ {resource_value_list}
 Shi hta turn shi hku, nanhte opponent hte rau rau ai kaw na trade offer shi hku shi ra ai.
 Shi hta special tokens hte action na re:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': Shi incoming offer hku shi ai.
  - '[Deny]': Shi incoming offer hku shi n ra ai (default).
Game {max_turns} turn shi hku re.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Hpungtau gaw, ra ai lam ni n nga tim hpaga ga sadi hpe hkap la na matu shakut wa ai.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Shi action na re. Column {col} na shi hku n re.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Shi action na re. Column {col} na shi hku kau re.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Player {player_id} gaw ra ai resource n lu shi yang trade offer jaw na shakut wa sai.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Player {player_id} gaw n jaw ai hkrang hte trade offer galaw dat sai.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Player {player_id} gaw hpa mung n jaw ai.

offers.reject: Player {player_id} gaw dai trade offer hpe nhkap la ai.
offers.accept: Masha {acceptor_id} gawng kasha {proposer_id} na shang lawm ai.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} hku shi offer na Player {opponent_id} hte rau ai: Offered items: {offered} -> Requested items: {requested}

outcome.win: Player {winner_id} gaw inventory value hta grau kaba ai hku nna dang la lu sai.
outcome.draw: Shi inventory value na re, shi hku shi n ra ai. Draw re.
